expected_observable_behavior.zh: 摩擦持续上升；第21天更换后转矩回到新件水平，生命周期编号变化。
expected_observable_behavior.en: Friction rises; after replacement on day 21 torque returns to new-part level and the lifecycle id changes.

ground_truth.zh: 摩擦 0→+0.6（0–20天）；第21天更换生成 M01-BS1-LC2；历史保留。
ground_truth.en: Friction 0→+0.6 (days 0–20); replacement on day 21 creates M01-BS1-LC2; history preserved.

expected_health_response.zh: 更换前 WARNING/CRITICAL；新生命周期初期无足够基线 → UNKNOWN；建立基线后 NORMAL。
expected_health_response.en: WARNING/CRITICAL before; UNKNOWN early in the new lifecycle without a baseline; NORMAL once a baseline exists.

abstention_cases.zh: 新生命周期在建立健康基线前必须弃权（INSUFFICIENT_DATA）。
abstention_cases.en: The new lifecycle must abstain until a healthy baseline exists (INSUFFICIENT_DATA).

abstention_cases.zh: 无失效数据：失效概率/RUL 必须返回不支持（NO_FAILURE_EVIDENCE）。
abstention_cases.en: No failure data: failure probability/RUL must return unsupported (NO_FAILURE_EVIDENCE).
